title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While language models have become dramatically more capable, retrieval still largely relies on lexical matching or similarity in fixed embedding spaces. This creates a capability asymmetry: what the retriever fails to find, even the strongest generator cannot recover. We propose DecisionRAG, which brings the capabilities of pretrained language models to retrieval using decision models that jointly evaluate candidate branches in a single forward pass, without generating any tokens, and show that judging candidates in a shared context makes their relevance estimates comparable. Like a person browsing a library, DecisionRAG navigates the corpus's inherent structure from broad topics down to individual passages, deciding at each level which branches are worth exploring. Without task-specific training or a first-stage retriever, DecisionRAG outperforms dense retrieval with an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial and 17.4 Hit@1 poin

translated_title: 无检索器的检索：利用决策模型导航文档
translated_abstract: 尽管语言模型的能力已经大幅提升，但检索仍然主要依赖词法匹配或固定嵌入空间中的相似度。这造成了能力上的不对称：检索器找不到的内容，即使最强大的生成器也无法恢复。我们提出了DecisionRAG，它利用决策模型将预训练语言模型的能力引入检索，该模型在单次前向传播中联合评估候选分支，而无需生成任何token，并证明在共享上下文中评判候选能使其相关性估计具有可比性。就像人在图书馆浏览一样，DecisionRAG沿着语料库固有的结构从宽泛主题逐级导航至具体段落，在每一层级决定哪些分支值得探索。在没有任务特定训练或第一阶段检索器的情况下，DecisionRAG在MultiDoc2Dial上超越带8B重排序器的稠密检索13.8个R@1点，超越17.4个Hit@1点...
tldr: DecisionRAG提出一种无需检索器的检索方法，利用预训练语言模型作为决策模型在单次前向传播中导航语料库结构，无需任务特定训练或第一阶段检索器即可显著超越带8B重排序器的稠密检索方法。
en_tdlr: DecisionRAG uses pretrained language models as decision models to navigate corpus structure in a single forward pass without generating tokens, outperforming dense retrieval with an 8B reranker without any task-specific training or first-stage retriever.
